prompt:
Goal: Create a wide two-panel photorealistic whimsical editorial collage featuring Alina Ai, a stylish young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black button-up outfit and white sneakers, appearing as multiple miniature-to-normal scale clones in cozy lifestyle scenes.

Canvas: Horizontal 2:1 split-screen composition, two equal square panels side by side, warm cinematic morning light, shallow depth of field, ultra-detailed, realistic textures, cozy beige and amber color palette.

Left panel: A magical modern kitchen morning scene. In the foreground place a giant white ceramic coffee mug with a cute expressive cartoon face: large brown eyes, raised black eyebrows, rosy cheeks, and a cheerful open smile. Beside it place a glossy red retro alarm clock with a similarly cute face, big eyes, blush cheeks, and a wide happy mouth. Add warm sunlight from a kitchen window, blurred countertop objects, plants, cookies in the lower foreground, and soft bokeh. Above the mug, create a glowing swirling steam drawing shaped like a smiley face with two oval eyes and a curved smile, with the words Good Morning written in glowing steam below the face. Show exactly 6 appearances of the woman in this left panel: 1 sitting on the mug rim pointing upward at the steam, 2 sitting inside/on the mug rim resting her chin thoughtfully, 3 sitting on top of the red alarm clock, 4 sitting on the alarm clock face/rim, 5 sitting on the countertop near the mug reading a small book, and 6 sitting large in the lower foreground leaning against the mug, touching her hair. Add glowing cursive text at the bottom reading Alina Ai with a small heart ornament underneath.

Right panel: A cozy beige interior wall scene with floating wooden shelves, warm ambient lamp light, plants, books, decorative items, a teddy bear, framed artwork, headphones, a camera, and a scooter at the bottom left. Arrange large vertical wooden letters on the left side spelling ALINAAI. Show exactly 7 appearances of the same woman in this right panel: 1 sitting on the upper left shelf reading a book, 2 sitting on the upper right shelf playing an acoustic guitar, 3 sitting on the middle left shelf using a silver laptop, 4 sitting on the middle right shelf operating a camera on a tripod, 5 sitting on a lower center shelf holding a small trophy, 6 sitting at the lower right holding a small potted plant, and 7 seated near the bottom center beside a framed print that reads "Alina Ai". Keep all duplicates naturally integrated with correct shadows and scale.

Visual style: Highly realistic, warm cozy editorial photography mixed with whimsical fantasy scale effects, cinematic lighting, polished social-media aesthetic, detailed facial features, glossy ceramic and metal surfaces, soft golden glow, natural shadows, clean composition.

Constraints: Use exactly 2 panels, exactly 13 total appearances of the woman across the whole image, preserve the readable texts, avoid extra random lettering, avoid distorted hands or faces, no watermark.

promptZh:
目标：创建一个宽幅双面板写实风格的奇幻编辑拼贴画，主角为 Alina Ai，一位留着深色长发、身穿黑色衬衫搭配白色运动鞋的时髦年轻女性，以多个从微缩到正常比例的克隆形象出现在温馨的生活场景中。

画布：水平 2:1 分屏构图，两个相等的正方形面板并排，温暖的电影感晨光，浅景深，超高细节，逼真的纹理，舒适的米色和琥珀色调。

左侧面板：梦幻般的现代厨房晨间场景。前景放置一个巨大的白色陶瓷咖啡杯，杯上有可爱的表情：大大的棕色眼睛、上扬的黑色眉毛、红润的脸颊和开心的露齿笑。旁边放置一个光亮的红色复古闹钟，同样带有可爱的表情：大眼睛、腮红和宽大的笑脸。添加来自厨房窗户的温暖阳光、模糊的台面物品、植物、前景下方的饼干以及柔和的焦外成像。在杯子上方，创造一个发光的漩涡状蒸汽图案，形状像一个笑脸，带有两个椭圆形的眼睛和一个弯曲的微笑，并在脸部下方用发光的蒸汽写上 Good Morning。在左侧面板中展示该女性的 6 个形象：1 坐在杯沿上指着上方的蒸汽，2 坐在杯内/杯沿上托腮沉思，3 坐在红色闹钟顶部，4 坐在闹钟表面/边缘，5 坐在杯子附近的台面上看小书，6 在前景下方靠着杯子坐着，轻抚头发。在底部添加发光的草书文字 Alina Ai，下方带有一个小爱心装饰。

右侧面板：一个舒适的米色室内墙面场景，配有悬浮木质搁板、温暖的环境灯光、植物、书籍、装饰品、泰迪熊、相框艺术品、耳机、相机以及左下角的一辆滑板车。在左侧排列巨大的垂直木质字母，拼写出 ALINAAI。在右侧面板中展示同一女性的 7 个形象：1 坐在左上层搁板上看书，2 坐在右上层搁板上弹奏原声吉他，3 坐在中间左侧搁板上使用银色笔记本电脑，4 坐在中间右侧搁板上操作三脚架上的相机，5 坐在下层中央搁板上拿着小奖杯，6 坐在右下角拿着一盆小植物，7 坐在底部中央附近，旁边是一个写有“Alina Ai”的相框。确保所有重复形象自然融入，并保持正确的阴影和比例。

视觉风格：高度写实，温暖舒适的编辑摄影风格与奇幻的比例特效相结合，电影级布光，精致的社交媒体美学，细腻的面部特征，光亮的陶瓷和金属表面，柔和的金色光晕，自然的阴影，简洁的构图。

约束：使用 2 个面板，整张图片中该女性总共出现 13 次，保留可读文字，避免出现多余的随机字母，避免手部或面部畸变，无水印。
